title: Chapter 455
paragraphs: Chapter 455
Episode 130. New Year, False Rumors, and Major Construction (4)
From that day on, major construction began immediately.
Jin and his colleagues had to spend their days without a moment to breathe, unable to spend time getting to know their new family members or share New Year's greetings.
It was because the major construction had literally started.
"Gongja."
Kashmir stood next to Jin.
They were standing on the barrier surrounding Tikan Free City, watching the progress of the construction.
With almost no external labor, the Black King members were moving and installing the equipment themselves.
The combat barriers were also brought by the Black King members.
Although the mountain base was their main base, they had many equipments for naval battles as mercenaries.
"Sir Kashimir."
Jin looked back at Kashimir.
"Thanks to Gongja, we now have a day like this in Tikan. Now, there are hardly any areas in the world with Tikan's level of defense, excluding the major powers."
Kashimir, who said so, had a very touched expression, and his moist eyes seemed to drop tears at any moment.
Suddenly, Jin recalled the thoughts he had before meeting Kashimir.
'When I wanted to establish a base in Tikan, I thought what Sir Kashimir needed most were the foundations of national power needed after the city was promoted to a nation.'
Tikan has a small population, few talents, and no resources.
It was a land that relied solely on the intelligence of the Seven-Colored Bird, and even after Jin's regression, it could not escape the fate of being a small country after the national promotion.
'So when I didn't know about the danger of the Cullon's Sacred Mirror, I wondered if I should propose a deal to share its efficacy.'
The mirror alone had created a defense system on a level that followed the major powers.
Both Jin and Kashimir.
They had achieved a remarkable result that they never considered when they first met.
Once the construction was completed, there was a high possibility that Tikan would be promoted from a 'Free City' to a 'Nation.'
That was the reason why Kashimir was so touched.
"As soon as the construction is over, I want to declare to the major powers and nations that we have also become a nation."
Kashimir changed the touched look on his face to determination and spoke.
"Yes, I thought you would."
"And if you wish, you may ascend to the throne as the first king of Tikan."
That was an unexpected proposal.
It was also a proposal he had no intention of accepting.
"Why on earth should I?"
"Because you have achieved more."
Jin was even more embarrassed because it felt sincere, not just something said for the sake of it.
"Aren't there some Knights in Runcandel who also serve as kings of some nations?"
"That's only symbolic. They don't actually carry out the duties of a king, they just hold the crown under the pretext of protection. It's not the kind of protection fee you like."
"I know that. And what I proposed is not meant like that."
Jin shrugged his shoulders and shook his head.
"No, Sir Kashimir. The king of a free country should be you. Besides, I am no different from a double-edged sword to Tikan."
"Gongja, a double-edged sword? That's not right. Why do you think that way?"
It's because I've seen it, how you and your people made Tikan a free country without anyone's help before my regression.
Jin didn't say that out loud and exchanged glances with Kashimir.
"You must know, Sir. When Tikan declares that it has become a nation, the major powers, especially Runcandel and the Royal Family, will be most resentful."
The four major powers.
Runcandel, Zipple, Vermont, and Kinzelro.
Among them, Zipple and Kinzelro were less likely to put direct pressure on Tikan even if it became a nation.
'As long as my father is around, Zipple won't easily mess with me or Runcandel. They might be able to apply indirect pressure, though.'
Kinzelro had targeted Jin this time, but she had also suffered considerable damage and fled.

'At least they won't be able to attack me until they recover. And Jepherin's behavior at the Black King Mountain Base was very different from how Kinzelro had dealt with me. I can't rule out the possibility that the attack itself was a unilateral decision.'
After the Black King incident, Jin and his colleagues had tentatively concluded that Jepherin was the devil dragon of the 'Kinzelro leader.'

-If it's that kind of powerlessness, it's certain that he's a direct dragon of a being of the Marquis class. There aren't many that come to mind, and I still don't know the name Jepherin. Either an ancient demon who was not active during my and Murakan's time, or an erased existence from history. It's one of the two.
-Erased from history...?

-It's not just about the old Runcandel that Zipple erased from history. As you know, there are quite a few people who have been erased from the minds of dragons who have lived through that era, like Archmage Chenmi.
-Then the leader might also be a victim of history manipulation. I also thought that when I saw Linpa brothers said they had met the leader before.

-Even if that's not the case, he could just be a naturally forgotten existence after losing in the ancient struggle for hegemony. Anyway, Jepherin's recovery will be slow. Such devil dragons usually borrow power from a Marquis or an equivalent being, and the leader was already in bad shape during the time at the Sword Emperor Castle.
The conversation with Quicantel after the Black King incident.
There were many doubts and unresolved questions, but one thing Quicantel was sure of was that Zephyrine, being the dragon of the commander, would recover slowly.
The reason why they judged that Zipple and Kinzelo would not directly intervene in Ticino's national promotion, even if they found it uncomfortable, was due to this.
On the other hand, Runcandel and the Imperial Family were different.

“Runcandel's response will depend on what decision Mother makes, but they will likely try to take as much advantage as possible from Ticino. They may ask for tribute at a minimum, and could even demand the assignment of missions. They could also force their way in, claiming they want to use it as one of the bases for the Guardian Knights.”
Of course, they didn't intend to just sit back and accept it, but it could be a significant burden on Ticino itself.

“I've prepared myself for that kind of issue. Besides, even without the Duke, pressure from the major powers would have been inevitable. Moreover, the Imperial Family is probably thinking that the Duke recently rejected the Emperor's proposal and is about to release evidence of the human experimentation.”
Kashmir smiled bitterly and continued.

“Ticino has been a thorn in the Emperor's side for a long time. If anything, it's because of the Duke that he can't act rashly. So I think that the national promotion of Ticino... is largely thanks to the Duke.”
Kashmir was unaware.
Before Jin's regression, Kashmir had once elevated Ticino to a fully independent nation without anyone's help.
Although Ticino at that time could not escape the fate of a weak country, Kashmir was called the King of the Fortress, defending their small territory.
At least as far as Jin knew, no force had threatened Ticino.
So Jin felt sorry.
Because of him, Kashmir and Alisa had regained Yuria, and achieved an impressive national power that was incomparable to the weak country before the regression.
But they also faced more risks.
'Will Ticino enjoy better situations in future wars than before my regression?'
It was a thought that often came to Jin's mind after his bond deepened with his companions in Ticino.
Was his regression truly only a positive influence on them, or perhaps it caused them to bear a more dangerous fate than necessary?
Of course, no matter how much he worried, he couldn't find an answer to that question.
Soon, Kashmir nodded as if he understood his feelings.
Of course, he didn't know about Jin's regression, but he accurately understood Jin's concerns.
Even without the factor of regression, forming a deep relationship with the special person called "Jin Runcandel" was a matter that required taking on many risks from the start.
From the moment they found Yuria, Jin had always been a person whose life was invaluable to Kashmir and Alisa.
It was the same for the other family members.

From the moment Quicantel saved Enya, from the moment Jett took in himself and his son, from the moment Kujan and Baelis learned the truth about Tyumen from Jin and took them in, and from the moment Julian saved the brain dragon Kaltor.
Recently joined Phantom Squad and Black King Corps also owed their lives to Faye and the members.
In this way, all the members of Ticino became family after Jin had first given them so much.
A relationship based solely on gains and losses was something they had transcended long ago.
“We are always prepared to make sacrifices for each other. Isn't that right, Duke? So don't think too much about it. Especially the expression of a double-edged sword is quite disappointing.”
Jin smiled and nodded.
“Even so, I can't become a king.”
“Then I'll just do it myself. Actually, it doesn't matter who among us wears the crown. I was just thinking of giving it to the Duke if he wanted it.”
“Oh... Then is it alright if I do it?”
The one who chimed in was Jett.
Jett was sweating profusely while carrying luggage and setting up equipment with the mercenaries.
With his unique charm, he was able to swim through the tense atmosphere between the Black King Corps and the Phantom Squad, ensuring that people on both sides did not feel upset.
Therefore, his comrades believed that Jett would play an important role in resolving the conflicts between the mercenary groups.
It was amazing to think that such a capable character had been a back alley informant in his previous life.
“Are you serious? If you want to do it, well... I won't stop you. I can clearly see what the future will be like though.”
“Hehe, I'm just kidding, Sir Kashmir. Actually, I stopped by to deliver some news. I heard it while passing through the hallway carrying the luggage... Ah, there she comes.”
Jett looked over to a woman waving her hand.
It was Quicantel. As soon as they saw her, Jin and Kashmir could understand what news Jett was about to deliver.
“Jin! He just regained consciousness. Come and see.”
The person Quicantel referred to as 'he' was the Black Knight they rescued from the Black King Mountain.
